newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Dock gets new CityFront offer.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Dock gets new CityFront offer.

text.p: The Chicago Dock and Canal Trust said it had advised Newsweb Corp that it had received a revised and "superior" proposal from CityFront Center LLC to acquire it for $25.00 per share in cash.
The trust said CityFront had increased its offer from $23 per share last week.

Earlier this month, Newsweb and its CDTC Acquisition Trust unit filed a lawsuit in the Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois, to protect its $21 a share agreement to buy Chicago Dock, a real estate investment trust.
It later made a new proposal to buy the trust at $23 per share in cash.
Chicago Dock said the court had declined on December 20 to issue a preliminary injunction to enjoin consideration and pursuit of the CityFront offer.
